# filmopen_automation

*Generated by `scripts/package_digest.py`; regenerate, never edit.*

The agent layer's in-app half (the MCP Specification): Flutter's driver extension, the protocol of its data channel, and the host that answers it.

**Flutter.** 5 files, 1,664 lines under `lib/`; 44 tests in 7 files. Barrel: `lib/filmopen_automation.dart`.

## Public API

What the barrel exports, file by file. A name is `class`, `enum`, `mixin`, `extension`, `typedef`, a top-level function, getter, setter or variable; under a class, its public constructors, fields, getters, setters and methods.

### `lib/src/driver_extension.dart`

- **function** `void installAgentExtension()` — Installs Flutter's driver extension with [handleAgentCommand] as its data channel.
- **function** `void installClipboardAsks(TestDefaultBinaryMessenger messenger)` — Sends the outgoing platform calls of [messenger] through [ClipboardAsks], as the product's binding does (§4.2).

### `lib/src/driver_host.dart`

- **class `DriverAutomationHost`** — The real [AutomationHost] of the agent build, installed by `test_driver/agent_main.dart` before `main` runs.
  - `DriverAutomationHost({ this.appVersion, this.logCapacity = 500, this.settleTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 5), Future<void> Function()? exitAppli…`
  - `final String? appVersion` — The app's version, for a recording's tape.
  - `final int logCapacity` — How many log events [logTail] reaches back.
  - `final Duration settleTimeout` — The longest an op waits for the animations its change started.
  - `void detach()` — Gives back what [attach] took — the semantics handle and the log sink — so that a test ends without an outstanding handle.
- **class `RingLogSink`** — The last events of the application's own log, for `log_tail`.
  - `RingLogSink([this.capacity = 500])`
  - `final int capacity` — How many lines are kept; the oldest goes first.
  - `String? lastEvent` — The name of the last event written, for `state`.
  - `List<String> tail(int lines)` — The last [lines] lines, oldest first.

### `lib/src/protocol.dart`

- **variable** `const String kPingCommand` — The handshake: a literal, so a one-line probe needs no parser.
- **variable** `const List<String> kTabIds` — The tabs `set_tab` names: an entity page's, in the order it shows them, then Settings', then the GPU page's three, then the Script page's `contents` and the scriptwriting plug-in's `workflow` (§9.3), then Activity's `…
- **variable** `const List<String> kThemes` — The themes `set_theme` names: `ThemeMode`'s own names.
- **variable** `const List<String> kClickKeys` — The modifier keys `click` holds, by name: each at most once in one click.
- **variable** `const List<String> kDragPlaces` — Where on its target row `drag` lets go, by name: one-sixth, one-half and five-sixths of its height.
- **class `AgentCode`** — What an answer's `code` says when `ok` is false.
  - `static const unknownOp` — No op of that name; `detail` names it when it is a well-formed name.
  - `static const badArgs` — An argument is missing or has the wrong shape; `detail` names it.
  - `static const notAvailable` — The host cannot do this: the product's no-op host answers it to every op, a host without [SemanticsTaps] to a tap by label or position, and a host without [AppExit] to `quit`.
  - `static const notFound` — Nothing on screen or in the project answers to the name in `detail`.
  - `static const refused` — The app refused, as it refuses a click; `detail` is the refusal's code.
  - `static const intercepted` — A question is on screen instead of what was asked for (the fork before Compare, the Software Specification §9.3); `detail` names what was asked.
  - `static const timeout` — The op could not be answered within its time, and `detail` says where it was.
  - `static const failed` — The host failed unexpectedly; `detail` is the error's type, and the log has the rest (`agent.failed`).
- **class `AgentError`** — Thrown by a host, or by the protocol's own checks, to answer an op with a code instead of a result.
  - `const AgentError(this.code, [this.detail])`
  - `final String code` — One of [AgentCode].
  - `final String? detail` — A code, a stem or an identifier; never a person's text.
- **class `SemanticsTaps`** — What a host answers beyond [AutomationHost] when it reads the semantics tree itself (`DriverAutomationHost`).
  - `Future<bool> tapLabel(String label)` — Taps the node whose label is [label], or whose label's first line is (a tab's label carries its position below it).
  - `Future<bool> tapAt(double x, double y)` — Taps at ([x], [y]), in logical pixels of the view, as a pointer would; false when the position is outside the view.
- **class `SemanticsScrolls`** — Reveals a lazy control through its region's vertical semantics actions, without activating it (§4.3).
  - `Future<int?> scroll(String identifier, {required String direction, String within = 'page.content', int maxScrolls = 20})` — Shows [identifier] within [within], moving down or up the page for at most [maxScrolls] actions.
- **class `MouseInput`** — What a host answers beyond [AutomationHost] when it moves a **mouse** over the page (`DriverAutomationHost`): a click with modifier keys held, as a person marks rows.
  - `Future<bool> click(String identifier, List<String> keys)` — Clicks the centre of the node [identifier], shown first, with a mouse while [keys] ([kClickKeys]) are held; false when no such node is on screen.
  - `Future<void> drag(String from, String to, String place)` — Presses a mouse on the centre of the node [from] and lets go at [place] ([kDragPlaces]) of the node [to], both shown and on screen before the press; [AgentError] `not_found` naming the one that is not.
- **class `FileAnswers`** — What a host answers beyond [AutomationHost] when it answers the next file dialog for the person (`DriverAutomationHost`): `pick_files`.
  - `Future<void> pickFiles(List<String> paths)` — Holds [paths] — each absolute and an existing file, else [AgentError] `bad_args` / `paths` — as the answer of the next file dialog, an empty list being a cancel; a second answer replaces the first.
- **class `AppExit`** — What a host answers beyond [AutomationHost] when it can end the application it runs in (`DriverAutomationHost`): `quit`, as closing the window does.
  - `Future<void> quit()` — Writes the open drafts, then has the application exit once this answer has left.
- **class `Recording`** — What a host answers beyond [AutomationHost] when it can drive the issue recorder (`DriverAutomationHost`, Software Specification §6.8): start a recording, stop it, and say whether one runs.
  - `Future<Map<String, Object?>> recordStart()` — Starts a recording: `{"recording": true, "folder": …}`, the folder null where the recording is kept in memory.
  - `Future<Map<String, Object?>> recordStop()` — Stops the recording: `{"recording": false, "folder": …, "events": n}`.
  - `Future<Map<String, Object?>> recordState()` — `{"recording": bool, "folder": …, "events": n}`.
- **variable** `final List<String> agentOps` — Every op the channel answers, `ping` first.
- **variable** `const Set<String> agentDiagnosticOps` — The ops that are diagnostics and never a step of a recorded sequence.
- **function** `Future<String> handleAgentCommand(String? message, { AutomationHost? host, Duration opTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 30), })` — Answers one message of the driver's data channel (the extension's `DataHandler`).
- **function** `Selection selectionFromJson(Object? json)` — Reads a selection in the shape of the state's [selectionToJson]; `epoch` and `stem` may be left out.
- **function** `List<Map<String, Object?>> findNodes(Object? tree, String query)` — The nodes of a semantics tree — a node is a map with an `identifier` and a `label` when it has them and its `children` when it has any, the shape [AutomationHost.semantics] answers — whose identifier or label contains…
